Use case: ui-mockup. Create exactly ONE polished high-fidelity desktop application screenshot, landscape 2048 by 1280, with exceptionally legible text. Only the application UI fills the frame, edge-to-edge. No device, browser chrome, collage, presentation title, explanatory arrows, inset image or decorative illustration.
Established NEXG merchant design: 230px ink-black left sidebar, gold NEXG wordmark, thin white line navigation icons; warm cream #f6f3ec workspace, white panels, subtle neutral borders, rounded 10px corners, near-black Manrope-style sans-serif type, compact professional spacing. Gold #d4a72c for the active navigation and one primary action, muted amber for an actual late task, muted green only for confirmed success. Do not use purple, gradients, giant KPI tiles, decorative charts or oversized empty whitespace.
Sidebar has EXACTLY these nine items, once each, in order: Home, Work, Offerings, Availability, Business, Money, Promotions, Insights, Settings. Help at foot. Shared top header: "Merchant workspace", small visible "Concept preview" badge; right side "Nairobi Collective", location selector "Westlands", notification bell, Help, circular avatar "ZM" and small "Owner". The preview is fictional sample data. Keep date and time prominent: 1 Nov 2026, Africa/Nairobi / EAT.
Scenario invariants: one fictional retail merchant, Nairobi Collective, Westlands. Source-confirmed order ORD-2048, customer "Amina K.", customer pickup. Confirmed automatically and stock allocated at 09:42. Promised ready time 10:00, never change it. Four item lines: Maize flour 2 kg, quantity 1, unit KES 240, line KES 240; Cooking oil 1 L, quantity 1, unit KES 320, line KES 320; Milk 1 L, quantity 2, unit KES 120, line KES 240; Eggs tray, quantity 1, unit KES 480, line KES 480. Items subtotal KES 1,280. This is not a guest payment total, payout or settlement. No private phone numbers, emails, surnames, addresses, payment credentials, API jargon or raw payloads. Contacts use "Secure message". Normal orders confirm automatically, with no Accept/Decline step.
Count definitions: Active orders includes orders ready for pickup and is not an exclusive stage. Initial active orders are ORD-2048 Packing, ORD-2047 Picking, ORD-2046 Ready for pickup, ORD-2045 Picking. Thus Active orders 4 and Ready for pickup 1. Completed today 8 is separate, closed work. Moving ORD-2048 from Packing to Ready keeps Active orders 4, increases Ready for pickup to 2, and keeps Completed today 8. One outstanding attention item is ORD-2048 until readiness is confirmed.
SCREEN 1 OF 3: HOME IDENTIFIES THE SPECIFIC PROBLEM.
Only Home is selected in the sidebar. Page heading "Home", subheading "What needs your attention in Westlands". Right of heading "1 Nov 2026 · 10:04 EAT" and "Updated just now". Beneath, a compact horizontal summary with four moderate-size values: "Needs attention 1"; "Active orders 4" with small "Includes ready orders"; "Ready for pickup 1"; "Completed today 8".
The dominant area is a "Needs attention" section containing EXACTLY ONE actionable amber-accented row/card. Title "ORD-2048 needs packing confirmation". Detail "Amina K. · Customer pickup · 4 item lines". Explicit timing "Ready by 10:00 · 4 min overdue". Status "Packing". Short useful explanation "Pickup readiness has not been recorded." Responsible party "Packing team". One prominent gold button "Open order" directly attached to ORD-2048. Tiny context "Opens this order in Work" below the button. Do not offer a misleading acceptance button or imply this task is already solved.
Below, one readable table "Active orders", subtitle "4 orders · includes ready for pickup". Columns "Order", "Customer", "Fulfilment", "Ready by", "Status", "Next step". Four rows:
ORD-2048 | Amina K. | Customer pickup | 10:00 | Packing | Confirm packing
ORD-2047 | Brian M. | Customer pickup | 10:15 | Picking | Finish picking
ORD-2046 | Grace W. | Customer pickup | 10:10 | Ready for pickup | Await collection
ORD-2045 | Peter O. | Customer pickup | 10:20 | Picking | Finish picking
Highlight the first row subtly, without creating a second competing urgent card. Table reference ORD-2048 is visibly clickable. Small "View all work" secondary link opens Work.
Footer note "Concept preview · Fictional records and outcomes". The design must make the exact next action unmistakable. No revenue chart, no generic business score, no unsupported claim of lost sales.
